meta.title: Events list and the Create Event menu: the "HISTORY2077" tab opens

steps.note: Open the Events list where the History tab is available.
Confirm the events list rendered with its Create Event control and no initial error.
Open the History tab, corresponding to the HISTORY2077 control described in the case.
Verify completed historical events are represented in the tab content.
Verify withdrawn historical events are represented in the tab content.
Confirm opening the History tab did not produce an application error.
